finding: CAL FIRE's incident record gives 23,448 acres (about 94.9 km²) burned. The official perimeter drawn here measures the same, and VIIRS satellites detected heat inside it on 7–12 January 2025.

layers.legend: Active fire detections · NASA FIRMS, VIIRS 375 m, 7–12 Jan 2025
layers.note: Each dot is a VIIRS pixel where heat was detected during one satellite pass. The dots do not show a fire front.

measurement.total_label: Total in the CAL FIRE incident record
measurement.firms_rule: Kept: VIIRS detections from the fire's start (7 January 2025 18:30 UTC, CAL FIRE) to its containment (31 January), whose pixel centre lies inside the official perimeter or within 375 m of it (one VIIRS pixel). Not kept: detections before the start (ten on 1 January belong to an earlier fire) and those farther from the perimeter (other fires or edge pixels).
